note: WS-A totality: a binding whose .frame is PRESENT but PARTIAL (x,y only, no w/h) is effectively zero-area — G::frame_overlap_x/y default the missing w/h to 0, so its overlap is 0 and it is filtered out (NOT an error, NOT a false winner). The well-formed cell B is the only candidate and wins. Distinct from frameless_binding_skipped (frame:null): this proves the `// 0` defaults inside the geometry primitives keep a half-built frame from crashing or poisoning the pick. The def is total over malformed-but-present frames.
